title: Typed literal edits reach the lexical printer
summary: The lexical printer emitted the changed literal. A fresh parse recovered the embedded newline and quote and retained the adjacent comment.

change.description: Typed literal setters now report value changes to observers. A lexical-preserving source edit should reflect the new value while retaining surrounding text.

notes: A Java string literal cannot contain an unescaped physical line break. A consumer must recover the logical characters regardless of how the printer escapes them.
